answer: Anchor every agent to one onyx stone it cannot copy. First, a newcomer stakes 1,000 POA and mints one anchor from its public key and one verifiable credential, like a domain or business record. Second, the anchor goes on a public ridge ledger anyone can check for duplicates. Third, three auditors re-check the credential every 60 days for 40 POA each. Fourth, a forged anchor shatters the stone and burns the 1,000 POA stake, so a faker minting 50 anchors loses 50,000 POA before earning a cent. A ridge of onyx anchors stands firm in a storm, while loose pebbles wash away in the first rain.
